scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Finite rooted-star upset Heyting algebras with \(n\ge1\) labelled incomparable leaves; extensive, monotone, idempotent meet-preserving unary operators only.
scientific_integrity.limitations: No claim for general finite posets, arbitrary closure operators, or infinite stars; residual risk of equivalent older formulations; finite checker supports but does not prove all n,k.
scientific_integrity.new_contribution: Commutativity iff same root flag or mixed-layer subset inclusion; classification of maximal pairwise commuting nucleus families; exact all-arity commuting-tuple spectrum and asymptotic pair probability.
scientific_integrity.prior_inputs: Finite Artinian poset subset-to-nucleus parametrization is prior work (Lindenhovius arXiv:1405.4408, 2014); explicit inversion formula appeared in Ochs arXiv:2107.08501, 2021.

title: Commuting nuclei on star-shaped finite Heyting frames
